sources.entry: Breaker - Watches the launchd jobs, cron jobs, Folder Actions, and SwiftBar plugins you set up yourself and notifies you when one breaks. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/wata/Breaker) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: Breaker is a macOS app that watches the launchd jobs, cron jobs, Folder Actions, and SwiftBar plugins you set up yourself and notifies you when one fails.
summary.what_it_does: Breaker is a native Mac app that gathers the automations you built into one list: launchd agents in ~/Library/LaunchAgents, your crontab, Folder Actions (AppleScript and Automator), SwiftBar plugins, and any apps you choose to keep running. It flags problems that exit codes alone would miss, such as a job that is not loaded, missed a scheduled run, points to a missing script or interpreter, or wrote an error to its log. When something breaks it sends a notification and shows a Dock badge, and it keeps checking every 60 seconds after its window is closed. For launchd jobs you can run, stop, and resume them, edit their schedules, and read stdout and stderr with error lines highlighted. Agents and daemons in /Library can be shown in view-only mode, and jobs installed by other apps are hidden by default.
use_cases: find out when a scheduled script silently stops working
monitor cron jobs on a Mac
check Folder Actions and SwiftBar plugins for errors
get notified of broken personal automations
edit launchd job schedules without hand-editing plists
how_to_run: Download the latest pre-built application from the Releases page and move it to /Applications
./scripts/install.sh (developers: builds a Release build and replaces /Applications/Breaker.app)
xcodebuild test -project Breaker.xcodeproj -scheme Breaker -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build/test (run tests)
notable: Catches silent failures such as missed runs, missing scripts, and error lines in logs, not just non-zero exit codes
Signed and notarized builds with automatic updates
Runs checks every 60 seconds even after the window is closed
Launchd jobs can be run, stopped, resumed, and have schedules edited in place
Includes a sample-data mode for taking screenshots without touching real settings
caveats: Needs permission to send notifications and control System Events on first launch
Building from source requires changing the signing Team to your own
